goal: Navigate to https://bidplus.gem.gov.in/all-bids to complete the goal: Type 'steel almirah' into the bid search box and run the search. If page 1 has no relevant bids, search once more using only the last word of 'steel almirah' (e.g. 'rack') and apply the same relevance rule. If the results allow sorting, sort by bid end date with the latest closing first. For each bid card read: bid_no (e.g. GEM/2026/B/1234567), title (the FULL 'Items' text; if it is cut off with '...', read the full text from its tooltip or title attribute, or open the bid details, and never return a value ending in '...'), item (the main product name), buyer (ministry and department), quantity, end_date (the 'End Date' value with time), doc_url (absolute link of the bid number, which opens the bid document). Look through up to 3 result pages to find matching bids. Today is 25 Oct 2026. Only keep bids closing on or after 27 Oct 2026 (skip anything closing sooner). Relevance: keep a bid only if its items/title describe 'steel almirah' itself or a close variant; never keep a bid just because the ministry, department or organisation name contains a search word. Return at most 10 bids. If a captcha, OTP or login wall appears, do NOT try to solve it: stop immediately and return blocked=true with blocked_reason and an empty bids list. blocked is ONLY for captcha/login/site errors: if the site works but nothing relevant is found, return blocked=false and an empty bids list. This is read-only: never click submit, participate, or bid buttons. Copy values exactly as shown (end_date with its time, est_value in INR as shown); use absolute URLs for doc_url; use an empty string for anything not shown.
